events.name: AI Tinkerers Atlanta — April Meetup

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – Community Day & Startup Showcase
events.description: Community Day kicks off Atlanta AI Week with a free, public Startup Showcase from 3–5 PM featuring execution-ready AI startups presenting live demos and pitches. A Community Happy Hour follows from 5–7 PM, open to the public with RSVP. This is the on-ramp to Atlanta's largest AI conference week.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – Startup Showcase
events.description: A free, public pitch and demo event featuring execution-ready AI startups building real solutions, running 3–5 PM as part of Atlanta AI Week Community Day. Come meet founders, see real products in motion, and connect with investors, operators, and builders. Part of the Southeast's largest AI gathering.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week Community Happy Hour
events.description: A free, public AI networking event immediately following the Startup Showcase. An open networking environment built for partnership conversations, pilot discussions, hiring and talent connections, and peer-to-peer AI strategy discussions. RSVP required.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week — Community Day & Startup Showcase
events.description: Community Day kicks off Atlanta AI Week with a free, public Startup Showcase (3–5 PM) featuring execution-ready AI startups presenting live demos and pitches. The day concludes with a Community Happy Hour from 5–7 PM, open to the public with RSVP required. No conference ticket needed to attend these community-facing events.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week — AI Collective Atlanta Community Activation
events.description: The AI Collective Atlanta is a featured community partner of Atlanta AI Week, activating its 150,000+ member global network at the event. As a nonprofit community of AI pioneers — founders, researchers, operators, and investors — The AI Collective Atlanta gathers members for intentional group discussion and connection during the week's programming. Attendees can connect with the local Atlanta chapter throughout the multi-day conference.

events.name: AI Tinkerers Atlanta – In-Person Hackathon (TBD)

Watch atlanta.aitinkerers.org for the official date announcement.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI Leadership Summit
events.description: The flagship day of Atlanta AI Week featuring the AI Leadership Summit with mainstage keynotes, 13 content tracks, 100+ sessions, workshops, panels, fireside chats, and VIP roundtables. Produced by the Enterprise Technology Association, the event brings together enterprise leaders, founders, practitioners, and investors focused on real-world AI adoption and implementation across industries.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week — AI Leadership Summit (Day 2)

Topics span AI leadership, ethical AI, creative AI, data management, AI project success patterns, Georgia's AI hub ecosystem, and more. The day concludes with a VIP Reception and Awards ceremony.

events.name: DevOpsDays Atlanta 2026
events.description: DevOpsDays Atlanta 2026 brings together engineers and leaders building real AI systems at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, and modern architecture. Sessions cover AI and modern developer practices to help teams build intelligent, scalable systems. Designed for leaders and engineers focused on practical execution, not just demos.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI for Business Summit
events.description: Day three of Atlanta AI Week features the AI for Business Summit, Women in AI & Tech Breakfast, and additional breakout sessions and networking. Programming spans three venues across Buckhead—Atlanta Tech Village, Roam Garage, and TechRise Atlanta—all within walking distance.

events.name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days | Atlanta

Developers of all experience levels explore practical workflows, real-world use cases, and AI-assisted coding techniques including Agent Mode and VS Code integrations.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week — AI for Business Summit (Day 3)
events.description: The third and final day of Atlanta AI Week continues the Southeast's largest AI gathering with enterprise-focused sessions on AI implementation, practical use cases, and business impact. events.name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days | Atlanta
